question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.**

The land near arid regions is not _________ (barren) enough for growing crops or any kind of vegetation.
solution: The correct answer is: **fertile** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Barren **means unable to produce offspring, unproductive, or infertile. (अनुपजाऊ) • **Example**: *The barren desert stretched for miles, lacking any signs of life.* • Marked option **Fertile **means capable of producing offspring, abundant in vegetation, or able to support plant growth. (उपजाऊ) • **Example**: *The fertile soil in the valley allowed farmers to cultivate a variety of crops throughout the year.* • **Complete sentence**: The land near arid regions is not fertile __enough for growing crops or any kind of vegetation. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • "**Devoid**" means entirely lacking or empty of something. (शून्य) • "**Arid**" describes an environment or climate that is extremely dry, lacking sufficient moisture for plant growth. (शुष्क) • "**Stark**" means harsh, grim, or severe in appearance. (कठोर) 38:T1064,
